nom: DIME TBT Eye Cream to Renew + Refresh

avis.texte: I noticed every time i opened it there was significantly less cream in it and it was getting harder. This was happening within the first month of having it. Now it is completely dried up and theres about a quarter sized amount left when i probably had only used a quarter size amount of the whole jar.

The lady at Ulta recommended this eye cream after I specifically asked for something to help with crows feet. I had been using Clarins Total Eye Lift, but was willing to try Dime since it was half the cost of Clarins. I will say that it does help hydrate under the eyes, but it does nothing for my crows feet. I'll be going back to Clarins since it does hydration and helps with the wrinkles.
I really needed a good eye cream because my genetics are against me with bags under my eyes! I have noticed a difference very quickly using this product.
Good product so far I have just started using it. Helps hydrate my skin around my eyes.
I slather this eye cream on every night. It's cooling and gentle and feels so good after a long day. This is a must for my skincare routine!
I love this product and so do my eyes! I won't go a day without it.
On my second jar, which I've never multi ordered an eye cream before ( so you know it's good!!)
I absolutely love the eye cream and I can actually FEEL it working within the first 3-5 mins of putting it on.
This is my favorite go to eye cream. It feels great, moisturizes, and wakes up my eyes. It's a re-purchase for me everytime.
Love this product because it's ewg verified and works very well.
I have been using this nightly and notice a clear difference in my under eyes in the morning! It's so soft and gentle

I have used Dime products for a few years now and this one has a horrible chemicals smell. It is so strong that I cannot use it anymore as it makes my eyes water and burns my nose. I usually reach for Dime because of the clean ingredients, but this one is off.

This product is amazing and has truly helped maintain my youth! You can feel the thickness of the product and it stays on alll night. There is no other eye cream I would use at night besides this one!

I added in the TBT Eye Cream to my nightly routine with the TBT Cream and Restorative Night Cream and I can see a huge difference! I previously had very noticeable dark circles and fine lines, and I can see a considerable difference! I love Dime and I love this eye cream!

I've been using Dime products for years. I often have friends ask what I use to keep my skin looking so good. The TBT Eye Cream is amazing! I love how it brightens and moisturizes around my eye. It is a must have in my skin care regimen.
I've tried a lot of eye creams and this one feels so good to put on and I can feel it absorbing until my skin and under my eyes! Definitely recommend!

This is a gentle eye cream- it doesn't burn my eyes and that is huge for someone like me with sensitive eyes. I haven't used it long enough to see results but i'm going to give this product at least 3 months and i'll give an update!

I'm new to this product I used Southbeach for numerous years then it stop working switch to dime products which covers a large age group. Very satisfied with the TBT line of products and other products.
This is a brand that I was not familiar with.So pleased with this product.This eye cream does not dissapoint.Very cool when applied to the skin and delivers a refreshed sensation.
It takes very, very little cream to feel the effects working!

avis.titre: Absolutely love the TBT Eye Cream!
avis.texte: I love the TBT Eye Cream so much that I order two at a time so I am never without!
These products have left my combination skin clearer and younger looking!
Can't say enough good about this! I'll never not have this in my regimen.
This is the most moisturizing eye cream I've ever used. A little goes a long way! My under eye has improved so much since using the cream. It looks nourished, less dry, less wrinkly.

Bought this as an eye cream retinol alternative, in my never-ending quest to find something that works...this does not work for me either. I went based off reviews, overall extremely positive, but this is just another one that did absolutely nothing for me and I can't justify the price.
Very gentle, buttery, silky smooth on the under eyes. Does what it says!

I use this every night and absolutely love it! I feel like it helps with the dark circles I get, and with keeping the wrinkles away around my eyes. I am 37 and have been using this for a solid year and have zero wrinkles around my eye area! I also using the brightening serum in the mornings.
Dimes TBT eye cream is incredible. Very light and absorbs into the eye area perfectly. I will definitely keep buying this product.
I haven't been using the TBT Eye Cream for very long, but so far, I like it. It goes on smoothly, moisturizes, and doesn't irritate my skin.

I was really excited to have eye cream again as I haven't been using any for some time. I used the TBT eye cream maybe 3x and ended up with extremely itchy, dry, flaky skin around my eyes and a small eczema that opened on one eyelid. This product is not for me. I was pretty surprised to experience this, as I haven't purchased several other DIME products and have found them to be gentle & effective. I guess we can't win 'em all. It won't stop me from purchasing from DIME. We love every fragrance we've tried and other skincare products.
This stuff blends in so well on my sensitive skin and doesn't irritate my eyes. Only been using it a month but so far I really like it.
I was shocked at the results of this eye cream…waaaaay better than anything you can buy in the store!
I have very sensitive skin and react to everything! But this eye cream is the exception! Soothing and effective and no itchy rash. Dime eye cream is now an essential in my skincare routine!

avis.titre: Did they not test this product?
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this product, but immediately turned off by it. I've never had any issues with sensitive skin or allergies and have tried almost every product under the sun, but the moment I applied this eye cream under my eyes, I experienced the most horrific burning in and around my eyes. At first it felt cold and then it started stinging, and my eyes were watering nonstop. There is an ingredient in this that is far too sensitive to be applied around the eyes! This is such a shame because the cream itself is great, even though it did dry up very fairly quickly in the pot once it had been opened. I do hope Dime is able to reformulate this product so I can give it another shot.
I love the TBT Eye cream!! If I skip this by accident Idefinitely can tell with wrinkles and fine lines showing.
This eye cream feels good going on and makes the eye area feel refreshed and moisturized.
LOVE LOVE LOVE! In my second jar and will keep using. So soft and moisturizes my skin beautifully! I love that it is a clean product. I highly recommend this cream.
This is my favorite TBT product! It is so cooling and makes my under eyes feel so moisturized!
One of the worst eye creams I have ever used. It pills underneath eye makeup. This product is terrible.
Makes my eyes feel refreshed after a long day. Has a cooling feel that is lovely
I like the texture and the fact that a little goes a long way.
I have tried several eye creams and this one has to have had the fastest results. Nourishing, moisturizing and tightening. Very good!
Dime is my favorite line I've ever used! I see and feel a huge difference, my skin is clear and so soft. One by one, my whole skin regiment will be Dime exclusively.

Caused contact dermatitis on my eyes so something in the ingredients irritated my skin, likely a fragrance of some sort. Not sure how well it works for others I was not able to evaluate because of the irritation to my skin
I am truly loving this new eye cream! Has a cooling effect around your eyes when it's applied. So much better than the other eye cream I used before this one!

Not sure what the deal is with this eye cream, but I had to wash it off due to extreme burning/tingling feeling. I usually love DIME products! I have never had a reaction like this to any skin care product, my skin isn't all that sensitive. Not sure if it's intended to feel this way, if so, they should state that in the description. Regardless, I will not use again.
Helps with the fine lines under my eyes. Give this product time to show you results!
Use this every night. Feels great, wake up super hydrated and radiant.
I can literally feel the skin around my eyes tightening after I apply it.

avis.titre: Not what I thought, a really bad reaction
avis.texte: I tried this for the first time last night and was so excited to give it a try! When I woke up my under eyes are swollen, red, slightly itchy and burning. Not exactly how I wanted to start my day. I would stay far away from this product and don't recommend this at all! I will be returning this.
This makes my eyes feel so moisturized, it almost has a minty-fresh feel.
I switched to Dime after having an alergic reaction to another brand. I like the way this feels on my skin after applying. No greasy feeling and moisturizes my skin.
This eye cream makes my under eyes feel so soft. I like how it feels when applying it. Too, it doesn't cause dry flakiness upon drying.
Love the eye cream. Feels nice and tingly after I put it on so I know it's working!

At first I was happy with this product, though it took time for my skin to get used to the tingling sensation. However, maybe two months later, the product has went bad. The cream coagulated, turning into a hard ball. Disappointing at this price point.

I'm loving this eye cream. The thick and creamy texture leaves the skin around my eyes plump. I like this style of container as well as it's easy to get all the product out as opposed to the squeeze tube.
This is just what my eyes needed! It's so light and creamy and a lot goes along way. Perfect way to refresh my eyes in the morning.
Ive tried everything under the sun. Always come back to the baaic Dime Eye Cream. I like it OK but I LOVE the TBT Eye cream!!!
Smooth, thick, and creamy. Sometimes stings my sensitive eye skin.
This cream is light, yet effective. My eyes tend to be dry and this moisturizer eliminates that. I also have sensitive skin and I don't have any issues with using it.
I don't know if it's helping with wrinkles or bags but I do like to put it on in the morning to help me wake up. It has a nice refreshing feel to it that definitely helps my eyes be more awake.

I don't ever really have reactions to products. I used this twice, a couple weeks apart, and both times my whole face was red and burning and my under eyes were swollen and tender. I only used the product under my eyes but my whole face had a reaction both times.

It may be a little to early to tell if the TBT Eye Cream is making a noticeable difference but I do love the feel of the product on my under eye bone and it doesn't cause my eyes to water which have been the case with all other eye products I've used in the past. It's definitely soothing. I'll have to revisit this review once I see a noticeable difference.

avis.titre: Best eye cream I've ever used!
avis.texte: My eyes are super sensitive to any eye cream I've tried. Anything under or near my eye. This is the first product that I have tried with no sensitivity issue and noticeable results for my wrinkles and dark circles. Absolutely love all the Dime products!

I've never had a reaction to a product like this. I don't have very sensitive skin at all, but my undereye started burning and turned red. I'll be returning. Maybe I am allergic to one of the ingredients?

This is my favorite eye cream! I have been using it for years!! It helps to decrease the dark circles and puffiness under my eyes. I have also a noticeable difference in the fine lines around my eyes. 10/10!
Really love this face cream, but this time it has a different color and texture.

avis.titre: Changed the texture of my skin badly :(
avis.texte: Used this product twice and woke up the next morning with the driest and weirdest texture under my eyes!! I freaked out because I've never felt so many tiny bumps and rough patches on my skin like that. so disappointing as I love all other dime products

I love this eye cream! It is thicker than the luminosity eye cream, but still feels refreshing on application and isn't too thick. It helps with puffiness and feels moisturizing, especially during these dry, cold winter months!

avis.titre: Great eye cream, but it d
avis.texte: Great eye cream, but it does have a "cooling" effect that i wasnt expecting.
Got this for christmas and used it a couple times, then didnt use it for a couple days and completely dried up
Weird texture and smell. It pills, too. Not worth the price! I've used drug store eye creams better than this.
I have pretty resilient skin but this eye cream immediately burned and irritated my under eye area. It wouldn't stop fir a very long time. Returning ASAP!

I received a sample of this eye cream. Put it on overnight and woke up looking like Blake Snell! Eyes all puffy and bags under my eyes. Worst product! Do not recommend! I don't have sensitive but something in this product did not agree with me.

avis.titre: Best eye cream I've tried so far!
avis.texte: I've recommended it to my friend and she agrees, it's awesome!
This cream gave very little moisture to my eye area, and actually rolled off underneath my eye makeup primer. Very disappointing.

After reading all the good reviews snd it being on sale i purchased. It has a cooling effect after you first apply it and layers well under makeup no piling but thats where the good ends. After using it for a couple of weeks my under eye wrinkles and lines are more prominent than before. I had been using another brand that i had received a sample of and it was good but i didn't know how good until i started using the Dime eye cream. The Dime actually reveresed all the good the previous 2 eye creams i had used. Not sure if it us just me but I am definitely not getting the wonderful results from the reviews of others. Everything works differently on different people so this product is not for me unfortunately

avis.titre: This is the best eye cream I've used
avis.texte: This is the best eye cream I have used. Better than the previous eye cream I used from Dime even. It doesn't irritate my skin and goes on so nicely.
I am really liking this product! My undereye area is firmer and brighter within just a few months of using the product.

avis.titre: I think I'm the only one who doesn't rate tjis
avis.texte: I bought this eye cream after reading all the rave reviews. Soon after using my eyes stung and the area around my eyes had gone extremely red. By the next day my entire eye areas were red and inflamed with dry, peeling areas starting to form. I tried to contact Dime but was told this product was not eligible for refund.
The TBT eye cream unfortunately burns my eyes. I love the tbt serum but my eyes are too sensitive for the eye cream. I'd love to exchange it. Barely used it.
Starting using this day and night and have noticed a big difference. Soften around my eyes! Definitely part of my routine.
The best eye cream. Hydrating, absorbs with a flawless finish.
I have noticed the fine lines around my eyes slowly getting less noticeable. The skin around my eyes seems less dry. It's worth it
Love this eye cream! I tingles when you put it on and feels refreshing.
I have noticed fewer lines around my eyes since using this product.
Absorbs completely and make my undereyes feel so hydrated in the morning.

avis.titre: Finally!!! An eye cream that does it all!
avis.texte: My criteria for eye cream is: fast absorbing, non greasy, moisturizing, depuffing. This one hits all the marks! And the texture is just right. Not too thick and not too thin. I won't use anything else, this is the HG of eye creams for me! So glad I tried it!
I'm loving the TBT Eye Cream. I have noticed that my wrinkles around my eyes are smoother, if I am consistent in using it every night.
I love this eye cream! It's so soothing and moisturizing without leaving your undereye greasy! I use it every night and love how it feels.

avis.titre: Wow! I look like I slept a full night
avis.texte: This is like magic in a little tiny tub. As a mom, my under eyes need all the help they can get. This cream is so thick and luxurious, yet goes on light.
Love this eye cream- it is very creamy and feels so good on my skin~
I am 26 with 2 kids and one on the way. Over the years I've just felt my under eyes looking tired and getting some smile lines. I can already tell this is helping brighten them and not look so weary.

I love this eye cream! It feels cool on my skin but doesn't make my eyes burn or leave my eyes feeling oily like I think most eye creams do. I do think it's helping the puffiness and dark circles too!
This is the 3rd time I have purchased this eye cream and I will never buy another brand. The noticeable change from before and after using this is impeccable. Love!!
I've been using this at night and the eye serum during the day. I really like the serum. I'm not sure if the cream is really helping with the circles under my eyes
